nodes.name: When Executed by Parent Workflow
nodes.notes: Entry point when a parent workflow calls this one. Set to passthrough: the calling nodes in the catalog declare no input fields, so whatever the parent emits arrives here unchanged.

nodes.name: Apply 'sync' Handling
nodes.notes: Normalises the routed job and records which switch arm handled them. Add the 'sync'-specific work here - this is the extension point the parent's switch was built around.

nodes.name: Return Handled Job
nodes.notes: Returns to the parent's Merge Routed Work node, which appends this arm's items alongside the others. `status` is set for consistency with the Post-Process libs; the branch callers only read the error rail.

parameters.content:
### When Executed by Parent Workflow

Entry point. Receives only the job the parent's switch sent down the 'sync' arm.

Next: Apply 'sync' Handling

nodes.name: Note: When Executed by Parent Workflow

parameters.content:
### Apply 'sync' Handling

Normalises the items and tags `route: 'sync'`.

🛠 This is where 'sync'-specific logic goes.

Next: Return Handled Job

### Return Handled Job

Writes `status`, `handledBy`, `route`, then returns to the parent's Merge Routed Work.

## lib: Process Sync Job

The 'sync' arm of a parent's **Route by Work Type** switch, for job. Shipped as a working passthrough so the branch completes end to end; the branch-specific rules are yours to add.

**Called by:** parent templates that reference `lib: Process Sync Job` in an Execute Workflow or Workflow Tool node.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Sync Job overview

parameters.content:
### Contract

**In:** the job the switch routed to 'sync'. No fields required.

**Out:** the same items with `route`, `handledBy` and `status` added, appended by the parent's Merge Routed Work node. Callers read only the error rail, so any additional field you add here flows on untouched.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Sync Job contract

parameters.content:
### Credentials setup

**None.** This lib calls nothing external, so it runs as imported.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Sync Job credentials

parameters.content:
### Troubleshooting

**The branch does nothing useful yet.** By design - the parents establish that 'sync' is routed separately, but none of them documents what should happen to it. Put that logic in the Apply 'sync' Handling node.

**Items appear twice after the merge.** The parent's Merge Routed Work is in append mode across all arms; check the switch is not sending the same item down two arms.

nodes.name: Note: lib: Process Sync Job troubleshooting
